problem_type: required canvas CI failure evidence omission
symptom: The required Linux Quality Gate could fail or time out in a real canvas journey without retaining the new canvas suite summaries, smoke diagnostics, or screenshots needed to identify the user-visible regression.
direct_cause: The Quality Gate artifact upload list predated the real-canvas suite and covered evaluation outputs but not the canvas acceptance output and screenshot directories.
class_root: A required end-to-end gate and its failure-evidence boundary were maintained separately, so adding canvas scenarios did not structurally require their machine-readable summaries and visual diagnostics to survive the runner.
affected_population: Maintainers diagnosing a required Linux canvas regression from CI
Contributors whose pull request is blocked by a canvas journey that passes locally but fails under Xvfb
Users protected by the required production-entry and real-canvas interaction gate
entry_points: Critical real-canvas suite summaries written under outputs/canvas-acceptance
Production canvas smoke diagnostics written under outputs/canvas-smoke
Card-stack walkthrough reports and real canvas screenshots
Quality Gate artifact upload after success, assertion failure, child timeout, or process exit
internal_only_reason: The artifact names and required CI jobs are Nomi repository contracts. GitHub Actions documentation cannot determine which Nomi canvas diagnostics must be retained for a failed user journey.
invariants: The required Quality Gate uploads canvas suite summaries, smoke diagnostics, card-stack reports, and critical journey screenshots even when an earlier canvas assertion fails.
Missing optional evidence warns instead of masking the original test conclusion.
Canvas failure evidence has a bounded retention period and does not include local user project data.
The workflow contract test changes with the artifact boundary so a renamed or removed evidence path fails before CI delivery.

recurrence.reason: Every Linux canvas failure can lose its diagnostics when a suite adds or renames output paths without updating the independent workflow artifact list.
same_class_scan: Scanned every output and screenshot directory written by the critical real-canvas, production smoke, and card-stack journeys.
Scanned the Quality Gate upload-artifact steps and verified canvas evidence is collected by the always-running diagnostics step.
Scanned artifact payloads for isolated test data only; local outputs remain untracked and no user project directory is uploaded.

prevention.strategy: Bind the required canvas journeys to an explicit always-running artifact allowlist and enforce the workflow shape with the repository workflow contract test.

migration: No application or project migration is required. Future Quality Gate runs begin retaining the new diagnostics; historical runs remain unchanged.
residual_risks: A future journey that writes evidence outside the declared directories still requires a matching workflow and contract-test update.
GitHub artifact upload service failures can still prevent retention, but they no longer result from a missing repository path declaration.
